source_snapshot.procedure: Run nvqual Test #18 Concurrent SSD FIO Test.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information should be readable with no spelling error and firmware version should be correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies licensed NVqual plus an SSD/FIO working set and warns about large I/O, but supplies no Test #18 job, immutable targets or result oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/IMPROVED; adds nonboot/disposable target and destructive-I/O safeguards while leaving the proprietary workload and acceptance unresolved.

old_problem: The Master names a licensed NVqual Test #18 concurrent SSD FIO workload but gives no command/configuration, target population, read/write mix, size/offset, runtime, queue/jobs, preconditioning, per-drive versus aggregate result semantics or performance/integrity limits. Its criteria only check presentation quality and firmware identity, so execution could destroy protected data yet still lack a hardware verdict.
disposition_reason: ED-04 requires exact nonboot serial-bound targets and protects mounted, RAID and valuable data; ED-14 prevents a shortened substitute; ED-15 forbids PASS without performance limits; ED-03 can parameterize ordinary device IDs but cannot invent the proprietary Test #18 job semantics or acceptance contract. ED-17 preserves evidence and ED-20 requires this independent decision. Therefore the review is complete but Pending remains.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row445 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3035 and next formal queue row446/history3036.

Official fio documentation confirms that `filename`, `rw`, `size`, `runtime`, `numjobs`, `iodepth` and direct-I/O options materially define the workload; none of the Test #18 values are available here.
Official fio protection against mounted-device writes is only a guardrail, not proof that an unnamed target is nonboot, disposable, outside RAID/LVM or authorized for concurrent writes.

No public NVIDIA source located an NVqual Test #18 release-specific command, target-selection contract or per-drive/aggregate PASS oracle; generic fio documentation cannot replace that proprietary specification.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row446 and verified its manifest identity; no NVqual, fio, storage write, log clearing or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: NVqual Test #18 concurrent SSD FIO qualification on serial-bound disposable targets
test_case.purpose: Execute the approved licensed NVqual Test #18 concurrent SSD workload on the exact authorized disposable SSD population and evaluate per-drive plus aggregate performance, integrity, health and firmware evidence using the release-specific project oracle.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVqual release/checksum/license, Test #18 guide/config and pinned fio version
Proof that every target is nonboot, unmounted, outside swap/LVM/RAID/device-mapper, disposable and backed up
Exact Test #18 read/write mix, block sizes, offsets/size, engine, direct mode, queue depth, jobs, preconditioning, runtime, concurrency and repeats
Per-drive and aggregate IOPS/BW/latency/integrity limits plus endurance/thermal/power/SMART abort and recovery rules
test_case.test_command: Do not execute until the NVqual owner supplies the pinned Test #18 artifact and resolved native job. Validate every target by immutable serial/WWN/namespace/BDF/slot and prove boot/mount/swap/LVM/RAID/device-mapper exclusion plus backup/disposable authorization. Review the exact FIO profile and projected write volume, preserve SMART/endurance/thermal baselines, then run the documented finite Test #18 once under OOB and telemetry. Retain native NVqual/FIO JSON or logs per drive and aggregate; do not substitute a generic FIO command or select devices by `/dev` order.
test_case.expected_result: Every authorized SSD participates in the documented concurrent workload, retains the approved firmware identity and data-scope contract, and meets the release/project per-drive and aggregate IOPS, bandwidth, latency and integrity limits without device loss, media error, disallowed SMART/endurance delta, thermal/power breach or collateral data change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PENDING: PASS/FAIL requires the exact Test #18 job and approved per-drive/aggregate performance and integrity oracle. Readable output, a correct firmware string or aggregate throughput alone cannot pass; no result is valid unless immutable target and protected-storage exclusions are proven.
safety_gate: Never select all disks or a `/dev` path without serial/WWN/namespace/BDF/slot binding
Hard-exclude OS, EFI, mounted, swap, LVM, RAID, device-mapper and valuable-data devices
Require explicit destructive-write authorization after showing the resolved job and projected bytes written
Bound runtime/concurrency, monitor health/thermal/power, preserve logs and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: Licensed artifact/config/fio hashes and release-specific Test #18 documentation
Resolved job options, preconditioning, duration, concurrency and projected write volume
Per-drive and aggregate raw performance/latency/error/integrity outputs
Firmware, SMART/endurance/thermal/power/log pre/post deltas, cleanup/recovery and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong-target indication, media error, device loss, latency hang, thermal/power limit or integrity failure, terminate all FIO jobs, preserve evidence, prevent further writes and follow the storage owner's recovery/restore procedure. Do not re-add RAID members, format, sanitize or auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: The procedure requires a concurrent SSD FIO qualification, while the Master criteria evaluate only readability and firmware. The proprietary job and technical performance/integrity oracle remain absent.

blocked.reason: A guarded future workflow can be described, so static review is not BLOCKED; execution and verdict remain Engineering Decision Pending on indispensable proprietary workload, data scope and oracle evidence.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Supply the licensed Test #18 job/guide, immutable disposable target set, destructive authorization, workload profile, technical oracle and recovery contract.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING; PROPRIETARY TEST18 JOB, SAFE TARGET SCOPE AND PERFORMANCE/INTEGRITY ORACLE ABSENT; NOT EXECUTED

pending.unlock_condition: Approve the exact Test #18 artifact/job, serial-bound disposable targets, per-drive/aggregate limits and recovery.

external_authorities.title: fio official HOWTO
external_authorities.applied_rule: Filename, rw mode, size, runtime, numjobs, iodepth and direct-I/O settings define materially different workloads and must be resolved explicitly.

external_authorities.applied_rule: fio can verify written data and exposes destructive-write safeguards, but those features do not authorize or identify an unknown production device.

external_authorities.applied_rule: NVQual is NVIDIA's qualification/stress toolset; the public page does not define Test #18 workload or acceptance semantics.

project_authority: Only the NVqual package owner and project storage authority can approve the release-specific Test #18 job, target/data scope, endurance budget and performance/integrity oracle.
